breakdown.description: The traction-free hole boundary is replaced by an artificial radial displacement constraint
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The original prompt contained contradictory instructions: to have a traction-free hole boundary and to impose zero normal displacement on the same boundary. The ground truth resolves this by specifying the boundary should be traction-free. The agent's generated specification included both the correct instruction (`Apply a Neumann boundary condition: traction t = (0, 0) on all other external boundaries, including the hole boundary.`) and the incorrect instruction from the original prompt (`Apply an additional Dirichlet boundary condition: zero normal displacement (u_n = 0) on the hole boundary.`). By including the incorrect constraint, the agent repeated the user's error and did not fix the problem.
